run_ml_neb_validation: run a validation of the ML NEB model on a set of NEB calculations using argparse CLI arguments
get_results_ml: get the percent success and convergence for the ML model using just ML energy and force calls
get_results_sp: get the percent success and convergence for the model with single points performed on transition states
parse_neb_info: parse ML NEB results and add barrier height, reaction energy, and convergence info to an entry dictionary
all_converged: assess whether a NEB calculation row is converged by checking ML, DFT, and single point convergence flags
